patterns.note: Content is presented in distinct, vertically stacked sections, each with a centered, fixed-width text block against a full-width background.
Major section headings are rendered in large, bold, uppercase sans-serif text, creating a strong visual hierarchy.
A stark, high-contrast black and white color scheme dominates, with minimal use of a subtle off-white for the hero text.
The initial full-width hero video section shrinks vertically as the user scrolls, allowing subsequent content to scroll up and visually overlay it.
A minimal header navigation remains sticky at the top of the viewport throughout the page scroll.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header navigation that persists at the top of the screen. The hero section, featuring a full-width video with a prominent 3D text element, dynamically reduces its vertical height upon scrolling, creating an effect where the main content sections appear to slide up and over the shrinking hero, eventually replacing it entirely.

Content is presented in distinct, vertically stacked sections, each with a centered, fixed-width text block against a high-contrast background, utilizing ample vertical whitespace for clear separation.

design_tokens.type_scale: large, bold, uppercase headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, regular weight body text and very small utility text in header/footer.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, especially vertically between major sections, with generous line spacing for body text.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its striking, sculptural 'REEL' text in the hero video, which interacts dynamically with scrolling by shrinking and being overlaid by content. This, combined with a stark, high-contrast black and white palette and minimalist layout, creates a bold and memorable visual identity.
